I need to flag something before planning this.

Approving rendered image assets isn't something these source files carry, and it's not something I do — I only edit the input files (character/location/scene sheets and the screenplay), and I never run or touch the image-generation pipeline. Locations don't even have an approval field in their front-matter (only characters have `status`/`approved_portrait`). So "approve all location assets except the stale ones" is an action for the desktop app / render pipeline, not for me.

To make sure I'm not misreading you:

The seat of Assayer power in Vorn: a fortress-chapter house of grey basalt and cold iron, its great door marked with the single iron key of the Grey Hands. Vaults hold rows of Nullifier Governors and the ledgers of the severed; the air is incense and machine-oil at once. This is where corruption reaches highest and where Isolde turns her faith into a weapon against its makers — walking in on a devotion she no longer owes.

The Halcyon family seat, a Loomwright-inclined house of pale terraces and glass conservatories perched above the cloudlanes, indigo-and-silver thread in every hanging. Far-speaking looms and treaty-chambers make it a place where wars are settled with words. Groomed to broker peace here, Seraphine returns having chosen to act rather than mediate — braiding scandal into a single coalition, and, at the last, choosing her own thread. The route's wedding is held on its cloud-terraces.
